displayName: Generic CLI (template - copy, rename, and edit)
notes: Template for any CLI with a noninteractive mode. Copy this file to adapters/<your-cli>.json, change the id to match the filename, and fill in ONLY flags you have verified against the CLI's own --help or docs. See docs/customization.md for the full walkthrough. Placeholders below are intentionally invalid (your-cli) so an unedited copy cannot run anything real.
